CustomField.description: Developer name of the email template sent to the applicant when a channel partner registration is rejected. Blank: no rejection email. In the template, [[Reason]] stands for the approver's comment; without a comment the part between <!--reason--> and <!--/reason--> is left out (text version: the line that holds [[Reason]]).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Developer name of the email template sent to the applicant when a registration is rejected. Blank: none.
CustomField.label: Rejection Email Template
